tf.keras.layers.AbstractRNNCell: Abstract object representing an RNN cell.
tf.keras.layers.Activation: Applies an activation function to an output.
tf.keras.layers.ActivityRegularization: Layer that applies an update to the cost function based input activity.
tf.keras.layers.Add: Layer that adds a list of inputs.
tf.keras.layers.AdditiveAttention: Additive attention layer, a.k.a. Bahdanau-style attention.
tf.keras.layers.AlphaDropout: Applies Alpha Dropout to the input.
tf.keras.layers.Attention: Dot-product attention layer, a.k.a. Luong-style attention.
tf.keras.layers.Average: Layer that averages a list of inputs element-wise.
tf.keras.layers.AveragePooling2D: Average pooling operation for spatial data.
tf.keras.layers.AveragePooling3D: Average pooling operation for 3D data (spatial or spatio-temporal).
tf.keras.layers.AvgPool2D: Average pooling operation for spatial data.
tf.keras.layers.AvgPool3D: Average pooling operation for 3D data (spatial or spatio-temporal).
tf.keras.layers.CategoryEncoding: A preprocessing layer which encodes integer features.
tf.keras.layers.CenterCrop: A preprocessing layer which crops images.
tf.keras.layers.Concatenate: Layer that concatenates a list of inputs.
tf.keras.layers.Conv2D: 2D convolution layer (e.g. spatial convolution over images).
tf.keras.layers.Conv3D: 3D convolution layer (e.g. spatial convolution over volumes).
tf.keras.layers.Convolution2D: 2D convolution layer (e.g. spatial convolution over images).
tf.keras.layers.Convolution3D: 3D convolution layer (e.g. spatial convolution over volumes).
tf.keras.layers.Cropping1D: Cropping layer for 1D input (e.g. temporal sequence).
tf.keras.layers.Cropping3D: Cropping layer for 3D data (e.g. spatial or spatio-temporal).
tf.keras.layers.Dense: Just your regular densely-connected NN layer.
tf.keras.layers.DenseFeatures: This layer can be called multiple times with different features.
tf.keras.layers.Discretization: A preprocessing layer which buckets continuous features by ranges.
tf.keras.layers.Dot: Layer that computes a dot product between samples in two tensors.
tf.keras.layers.EinsumDense: This layer can perform einsum calculations of arbitrary dimensionality.
tf.keras.layers.Embedding: Turns positive integers (indexes) into dense vectors of fixed size.
tf.keras.layers.Flatten: Flattens the input. Does not affect the batch size.
tf.keras.layers.GRU: Gated Recurrent Unit - Cho et al. 2014.
tf.keras.layers.GRUCell: Cell class for the GRU layer.
tf.keras.layers.GlobalAveragePooling1D: Global average pooling operation for temporal data.
tf.keras.layers.GlobalAveragePooling2D: Global average pooling operation for spatial data.
tf.keras.layers.GlobalAveragePooling3D: Global Average pooling operation for 3D data.
tf.keras.layers.GlobalAvgPool1D: Global average pooling operation for temporal data.
tf.keras.layers.GlobalAvgPool2D: Global average pooling operation for spatial data.
tf.keras.layers.GlobalAvgPool3D: Global Average pooling operation for 3D data.
tf.keras.layers.GlobalMaxPool1D: Global max pooling operation for 1D temporal data.
tf.keras.layers.GlobalMaxPool2D: Global max pooling operation for spatial data.
tf.keras.layers.GlobalMaxPool3D: Global Max pooling operation for 3D data.
tf.keras.layers.GlobalMaxPooling1D: Global max pooling operation for 1D temporal data.
tf.keras.layers.GlobalMaxPooling2D: Global max pooling operation for spatial data.
tf.keras.layers.GlobalMaxPooling3D: Global Max pooling operation for 3D data.
tf.keras.layers.HashedCrossing: A preprocessing layer which crosses features using the "hashing trick".
tf.keras.layers.Hashing: A preprocessing layer which hashes and bins categorical features.
tf.keras.layers.InputLayer: Layer to be used as an entry point into a Network (a graph of layers).
tf.keras.layers.InputSpec: Specifies the rank, dtype and shape of every input to a layer.
tf.keras.layers.IntegerLookup: A preprocessing layer which maps integer features to contiguous ranges.
tf.keras.layers.LSTMCell: Cell class for the LSTM layer.
tf.keras.layers.Lambda: A better pattern is to write a subclassed Layer:
tf.keras.layers.Layer: This is the class from which all layers inherit.
tf.keras.layers.LeakyReLU: Leaky version of a Rectified Linear Unit.
tf.keras.layers.Masking: Masks a sequence by using a mask value to skip timesteps.
tf.keras.layers.MaxPool1D: Max pooling operation for 1D temporal data.
tf.keras.layers.MaxPool2D: Max pooling operation for 2D spatial data.
tf.keras.layers.MaxPooling1D: Max pooling operation for 1D temporal data.
tf.keras.layers.MaxPooling2D: Max pooling operation for 2D spatial data.
tf.keras.layers.Maximum: Layer that computes the maximum (element-wise) a list of inputs.
tf.keras.layers.Minimum: Layer that computes the minimum (element-wise) a list of inputs.
tf.keras.layers.Multiply: Layer that multiplies (element-wise) a list of inputs.
tf.keras.layers.Normalization: A preprocessing layer which normalizes continuous features.
tf.keras.layers.Permute: Permutes the dimensions of the input according to a given pattern.
tf.keras.layers.RandomBrightness: A preprocessing layer which randomly adjusts brightness during training.
tf.keras.layers.RandomContrast: A preprocessing layer which randomly adjusts contrast during training.
tf.keras.layers.RandomCrop: A preprocessing layer which randomly crops images during training.
tf.keras.layers.RandomFlip: A preprocessing layer which randomly flips images during training.
tf.keras.layers.RandomHeight: A preprocessing layer which randomly varies image height during training.
tf.keras.layers.RandomRotation: A preprocessing layer which randomly rotates images during training.
tf.keras.layers.RandomTranslation: A preprocessing layer which randomly translates images during training.
tf.keras.layers.RandomWidth: A preprocessing layer which randomly varies image width during training.
tf.keras.layers.RandomZoom: A preprocessing layer which randomly zooms images during training.
tf.keras.layers.Rescaling: A preprocessing layer which rescales input values to a new range.
tf.keras.layers.Reshape: Layer that reshapes inputs into the given shape.
tf.keras.layers.Resizing: A preprocessing layer which resizes images.
tf.keras.layers.SimpleRNN: Fully-connected RNN where the output is to be fed back to input.
tf.keras.layers.StackedRNNCells: Wrapper allowing a stack of RNN cells to behave as a single cell.
tf.keras.layers.StringLookup: A preprocessing layer which maps string features to integer indices.
tf.keras.layers.TextVectorization: A preprocessing layer which maps text features to integer sequences.
tf.keras.layers.TimeDistributed: This wrapper allows to apply a layer to every temporal slice of an input.
